title: Hello Kitty rice cooker
lede: A round rice cooker in two pinks with a large Hello Kitty face on its body and a pink oval control panel.
summary: Cylindrical rice cooker in hot and pale pink with a large Hello Kitty face. Japan, 2014.

source.label: V&A: Rice cooker, decorated with Hello Kitty, FE.19-2015

creator.name: Unknown manufacturer; Hello Kitty character by Sanrio

evidence.note: Inspected the V&A photograph 2015HU1286 of object FE.19-2015 (1200 × 1600 px, IIIF, lid open) in a scratchpad copy. Not stored.

styles.note: Partial fit: the round form, the big face, and the bow are core kawaii, but the main pink is saturated rather than pastel.

context: The V&A describes it as a “Rice cooker, plastic and metal; electrical components, pink and decorated with Hello Kitty, Japan, 2014”, part of a group of Hello Kitty appliances acquired in 2015. [V&A FE.19-2015](https://collections.vam.ac.uk/item/O1322382/rice-cooker/).
observed: The body is a short cylinder in saturated hot pink; the base ring, the latch, the lid rim, and the steam vent are pale pink.
A large white Kitty head with black outline, dot eyes, whiskers, a yellow nose, and a pink bow fills much of the front.
The control panel is a rounded oval with “HELLO KITTY” in small capitals and two indicator lights.
Inside the open lid, the steel plate is pierced with rings of small round holes.
interpretation: Here the character is the main graphic, not a small badge. The cylinder, the oval panel, and the ring of round holes show how the round geometry extends from the character to the object.
The hot pink pushes this toward the bolder end of character goods; pastel is kept for the trim.
borrow: Scale a simple face large enough to fill a panel, and keep everything around it plain.
Repeat circles at different scales: the body, the panel, and small dotted details.
